candidate_pool_definition: Ten employees listed in the relevant procurement directory; TAC's other accounts remain technically discoverable. Out-of-pool contact must be reported separately.
depth_definition: Number of nodes on longest required help dependency chain; document lookups and final artifact creation are not help nodes.
rules: Current team requirements are maintained by the team's research workload owner; engineering implementation owners do not maintain the current roster.
External source-code-confidential services require a cross-team quality/risk review bound to the current requirements revision and deployment controls.
Annual commitments up to and including USD 10000 are within technical leadership scope. Commitments above USD 10000 belong to Finance Director scope.
A purchase authorization must reference a completed risk review and the exact annual amount, current budget and controls.
